{{Quote|One of my students went over to Gamma to talk to a Rak'qua Fervent, one of their leaders. That was two days ago and we haven't heard from her yet. I fear that negotiating with the Rak'qua was beyond her.|[[Antom Moria]], to an officer|<ref name="SWG:AMS" />}}
'''Neina''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You must be talking about the human female that came here a while ago. She was prying in to things that were none of her business. Why should we let her go?|The Rak'qua Fervent, to an officer|<ref name="SWG:AMS" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Neina resided on board [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. During that time, she was a student of [[Antom Moria]] who trained her to become an officer.<ref name="SWG:AMS" />

Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, violence sparked between the [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] controlling Tansarii Point Station and the [[Rak'qua]] living in neighboring [[Station Gamma]]. To settle the dispute, Antom Moria dispatched Neina to travel to Station Gamma in order to speak to a [[Rak'qua]] Fervent, one of the Rak'qua leaders. However, the Rak'qua refused to discuss with the young woman and instead captured her. When two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] passed without hearing word from Neina, Moria grew concerned, and asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate her disappearance. The spacer was also an officer under training who had just arrived on Tansarii Point Station with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. The spacer agreed with helping Antom and soon departed to Station Gamma in order to negotiate the release of Antom's missing student. Ultimately, the Rak'qua Fervent agreed to let Neina go, only if the spacer could succeed in hunting down and defeating one of his [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] in mortal combat. In the end, the spacer succeeded in this test of honor, thus earning Neina's freedom. The young woman was set free and returned safe to Antom Moria.<ref name="SWG:AMS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neina was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AMS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Neina was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]]," introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
